describe.reports: its pages, layer count, selection, tool, and undo state
describe.covers: frames, shapes, text, auto layout, components, styles, variables, prototyping, and more

query.description: A panel's answer as JSON: pages, layers, selection, node, document, selectionColors, componentProperties, instanceExposed, prototype, components, styles, variables, devInspect, code, componentCode, devAssets, readyForDev, annotations, annotationCategories, measurements, devResources, comments, versions, branches, framePresets, fonts, documentColors, imagePresets, vectorEdit, textSelection, menus, checked, exportSettings, fontFamilies, font, missingFonts, textStyles, recentColors, prefs, keymap, toolbar, layersAt, distances, paddingLines, redlines, commentPeople, commentPins, protoConnections, paintHandles, blurHandles, playground, evaluate, vectorBounds, shapeBuilderRegions, variable.modeRows, clipboard.paintState, image.info, history, layers.dropInfo, assets.list, drop.preview, library.list, library.updates, library.files, variables.pickFor, menu.context, hitTest, rename.preview, prefs.recentActions, layout.gridGeometry, arrange.spacingInfo, dev.focusState, dev.compare, codeLinks, annotation.callouts, version.previewState, proto.destinations, proto.parseExpression (bindings/wasm/src/query.rs, canvas.rs, panels.rs, lists.rs)

chrome.description: The canvas chrome in document pixels as JSON: frame labels, the size pill, auto layout padding and gap handles, layout grids, the pixel grid, rulers, ruler guides (bindings/wasm/src/chrome.rs)

exportNode.description: One layer exported as png, jpg, webp, svg, pdf, or xml at scale: the file's bytes

exportNodeWith.description: One layer exported with an export setting's options ({ index?, setting?: { format, size, contentsOnly, includeBoundingBox, svgOutlineText, svgIdAttribute, svgSimplifyStroke, print, vdCompat }, format?, scale? }): the file's bytes (bindings/wasm/src/query.rs)

thumbnail.description: A PNG thumbnail of the first page

beginInteraction.description: Starts an interaction: the edits until commitInteraction are one undo step named label (number scrubs, colour drags, handle drags); true when this call opened it, false when one was open already (bindings/wasm/src/view.rs)

commitInteraction.description: Ends the editor's interaction as one undo step; true when it recorded one

cancelInteraction.description: Abandons the editor's interaction and restores the document; true when there was one

setViewport.description: Tells the engine the editor's view: document pixel (x, y) at the viewport's top-left, width x height screen pixels, zoom; never an edit

viewTarget.description: Where a View menu zoom command (view.zoomFit, view.zoomSelection, view.zoom100, view.zoomIn, view.zoomAt, view.nextFrame, ...) takes the view, as JSON { zoom, x, y, centerX, centerY, rect, selection } in document pixels, for the editor to animate its own viewport (bindings/wasm/src/view.rs)

nodeThumbnail.description: A layer drawn to fit a size x size square (at most 2x) as a transparent PNG: layer and asset thumbnails (bindings/wasm/src/preview.rs)

textPreview.description: Text drawn in its own font as a transparent PNG, for font lists ({ family, style?, size?, text? }) and text style samples ({ styleId }), with color, scale, maxWidth, maxHeight (bindings/wasm/src/preview.rs)

samplePixel.description: The colour the canvas shows at a document pixel, #rrggbb: the colour picker's eyedropper

strokePreviewOutline.description: A brush's outline ({ preset, width?, height? }) along a short line as SVG path data in CSS pixels, stroked with 1 px lines by the Stroke section's brush rows (bindings/wasm/src/panels.rs)

setHover.description: Outlines a layer on the canvas as the hover does (null clears it), shared with the layers panel; inspect().hover reads it back; never moves the revision (bindings/wasm/src/view.rs)

setDevMode.description: Turns the engine's Dev Mode tool state on or off (measure on hover, no handles, ends text and vector editing); true when it changed (bindings/wasm/src/view.rs)

player.description: The prototype player (start, stop, state, tick, event, restart, back, closeOverlay, scrollTo, resize, inspect) as JSON { handled, changed, missed, cursor, links, transition, state }, inspect as { id, name, bounds, clip, sections }; never changes the document (bindings/wasm/src/player.rs)

playerRender.description: The player's screen ({ scale?, format?: png or rgba, progress?, state?: current or from }) as PNG bytes, or RGBA: the picture's width and height (two little-endian u32) then its pixels; the last transition drawn at progress (bindings/wasm/src/player.rs)

devCompareRender.description: Dev Mode's compare view picture ({ id?, version?, side: before or after, maxSide? }) as a PNG, at the scale query('dev.compare') gives (bindings/wasm/src/lists/dev.rs)

playgroundPreview.description: A component playground's instance with the chosen property values ({ id?, properties?, scale?, maxSide? }) as a PNG; never changes the document (bindings/wasm/src/lists/dev.rs)

lendLibrary.description: Lends the library file a design names (query('library.files'): a workspace path relative to the document's folder) as the editor read it with host/read, or null when it can't be read; the engine reads library files through it, else through the host's lent files; never an edit; true when what the path reads changed (bindings/wasm/src/libraries.rs)

libraryThumbnail.description: A component or set of an enabled library drawn from its published snapshot to fit a size x size square, as a PNG: the Assets panel's library tiles (bindings/wasm/src/libraries.rs)

recordAction.description: Remembers an action run from the Actions palette for its Recents (query('prefs.recentActions')), newest first; session only (bindings/wasm/src/lists.rs)
